RT Connor Bates
The 50/80 Rule has been playing out in full force over the past few months.
Once a secular market leader makes a major top, theres a 50% chance it will decline by 80% and an 80% chance it will decline by 50%, with an average decline of over 70%. 
The first ones to fall: 
$ANF - 63% off highs 
$SMCI - 67% off highs 
$ELF - 75% off highs 
Recently: 
$APP - 55% off highs 
$HIMS - 62% off highs 
$VRT - 60% off highs 
$VST - 48% off highs 
$NVDA - 36% off highs 
$AVGO - 38% off highs 
$TSLA - 52% off highs 
“The markets take the stairs up and the elevator down”
